fields.name: Reason Preferred Agents Cannot Be Used
fields.question: Identify why the preferred agents cannot be used:
fields.answer: Patient has a longstanding history of chronic migraines and has tried multiple prophylactic medications including Propranolol, Verapamil, Topiramate, Nortriptyline, Venlafaxine, Gabapentin, nerve blocks, and others with inadequate response, and continues to experience chronic daily headaches despite these interventions. She was also off Aimovig (a CGRP inhibitor) since December, and desires Vyepti as an alternative to Botox for prevention due to ongoing chronic daily headaches.
